# Sibe

> Sibe is a cloud CAD management workspace for SolidWorks teams. It connects SolidWorks version control, CAD file management, revision approval workflows, BOM data, and browser-based design collaboration.

## Canonical pages

- [Sibe cloud CAD management homepage](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/): Product overview for cloud CAD management for SolidWorks.
- [Cloud CAD management for SolidWorks teams](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/cloud-cad-management/): Version control, remote access, browser reviews, product data, and evaluation workflow.
- [CAD file management](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/cad-file-management/): SolidWorks files, references, metadata, versions, and review workflow.
- [SolidWorks revision approval workflow](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/solidworks-revision-approval-workflow/): In Progress, Pending Approval, Released, review notes, and release history.
- [SolidWorks BOM management](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/solidworks-bom-management/): Assembly structure, part metadata, version-aware product data, and manufacturing exports.
- [Remote engineering collaboration](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/remote-team-collaboration-for-solidworks-teams/): Browser-based 2D/3D reviews, controlled sharing, and distributed team collaboration.
- [SolidWorks PDM migration](https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/cloud-pdm/solidworks-pdm-migration/): A phased evaluation approach for moving from traditional PDM workflows toward cloud CAD management.
